faqs.question: How can I contact you?
faqs.answer: You can contact GrowthsStack.Dev via email at moyih50210@gmail.com or through the LinkedIn, GitHub, and Instagram profiles listed on the portfolio.

faqs.question: Can I email you?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can send project inquiries to moyih50210@gmail.com.

faqs.question: Do you have LinkedIn?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can connect through the LinkedIn profile available on the GrowthsStack.Dev portfolio.

faqs.question: Do you have GitHub?
faqs.answer: Yes. GitHub repositories are available through the GrowthsStack.Dev profile.

faqs.question: How do I start a project?
faqs.answer: Contact via email and share your project idea, business goals, required features, timeline, and any relevant details.

faqs.question: Can we schedule a discussion?
faqs.answer: Yes. Please contact via email with your project requirements, and the next steps can be discussed.

faqs.question: Do you work remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. GrowthsStack.Dev works remotely with clients.

faqs.question: What should I include in my project inquiry?
faqs.answer: Include your project idea, business goals, required features, AI requirements, integrations, timeline, and any reference material you have.

response_rules: Always provide the public email address exactly as listed.
Do not invent a phone number, WhatsApp number, office address, or meeting link.
If the user asks for contact methods not listed, explain that only the publicly available contact methods can be shared.
Encourage the user to include project goals and requirements in their first message.
